title: AI leadership role event
description: One dated, publicly sourced AI-leadership role event at an institution in the population (METHODOLOGY §11). The unit of observation is the EVENT, not the person and not the institution: a row in data/roles.jsonl records that something happened to an AI-leadership role on a given date, with the wording that carries the claim quoted verbatim. A role event never moves an adoption stage.

id.description: ULID. Sortable by creation time, stable across edits, and generated by tools/review.py at filing.

institution.description: Must match a name or alias in the population: data/institutions.json, data/not_classified.json, or data/roles_expansion.json. not_classified entries carry no aliases, so those match on name only.

title_verbatim.description: The title exactly as the source prints it, in the source's own language. Never translated, never tidied.

title_normalized.description: The comparison key. Normalization rule in METHODOLOGY §11 — it maps a verbatim title to a bucket and never invents seniority the title does not state.

person.description: Named individual, or null. A name is recorded ONLY from a firm press release, a firm leadership page, a regulatory filing, or an outlet meeting the T1 or T2 criteria in SOURCES.md. Never from LinkedIn or any other profile aggregator. null is a valid, complete answer.

event_type.description: retitled = the SAME person under a new AI-inclusive title. It is not a new role and must never be counted as one.

date.description: Variable precision, preserved verbatim exactly as data/institutions.json events do: "2024", "2026-03", or "2026-03-24". Never padded, never normalized.

reporting_line.description: Who the role reports to, per the source. unknown when the source does not say — it is never inferred from the title.

scope.description: firm_wide or division, per the source. unknown when the source does not say.

source_url.description: Exactly one URL, and one that was actually opened.

quote_verbatim.description: The wording from the source that carries the claim, quoted verbatim in its original language.

language.description: BCP-47 language subtag of quote_verbatim and title_verbatim ("en", "ja", "zh-Hans").

confidence.description: Strength of the public evidence for this event, on the same scale the dashboard uses for stages.

rationale.description: Why this event reads the way it is coded, and what it stops short of showing.

as_of_reviewed.description: REVIEWER-ONLY. Written by tools/review.py --roles on filing. A PR that sets it is rejected.

label_provenance.description: REVIEWER-ONLY. Whether the filed event_type was the agent's proposal accepted, revised, or written by the human outright. Set once, on first review.

agent_proposed_event_type.description: REVIEWER-ONLY. The event_type the screener proposed, or null when the event was human-originated. The anchored-agreement caveat in METHODOLOGY §6 applies here unchanged.
